commands: Compare independently reproduced overlay output SHA-256 values recorded in reproducibility-v1.json.

conclusions.text: Supported: every one of the 134 exact archived component geometries intersects a current RESOLVE source polygon named Arabian sand desert (ECO_ID 810) or Arabian-Persian Gulf coastal plain desert (ECO_ID 811). 132 have positive-area intersection with ECO_ID 811; two have zero-area contact with ECO_ID 810 at captured source precision. This is evidence of current source-footprint intersection, not cause or historical source-byte equality.

Supported: the retained complete geoBoundaries ARE ADM1 file has the Abu Dhabi source feature intersecting all 134; its Dubai source feature intersects one selected component. The pinned current Atlas desert subject geometries also intersect all 134, and the current Dubai contact feature intersects one. These predicates do not assign authority or prove historical source equivalence.

Unresolved: the original .cache/semantic/resolve-ecoregions.geojson source bytes and full-file digest used by the historic refinement step are unavailable in the pinned baseline. The present service snapshot cannot substitute for that historic source.

Unresolved: whether any selected residual arose from make_valid, 0.001-degree simplification, 1e-8 degree operation grid, area thresholds, or recorded per-district coastline adjustment bands. The historic code and shared adjustment metadata identify plausible mechanisms only, not component-level causality.
Unresolved: independently evidenced water/ice status for all 134 components. Archived surface status remains unverified; no water inference is made from ecological/admin polygons or point contacts.

methods.description: Exact Shapely topological predicates and raw intersection dimensionality/area/length on unmodified two-dimensional GeoJSON coordinate arrays; retains original features and records native coordinate units; no buffers, snapping, transforms, assignment, or water inference.
methods.software: Python 3.12.14; Shapely 2.1.2; EPSG:4326 source axes; evidence.immutable Baseline/canonical_json for immutable input and output bytes.
methods.units: Intersection area in native degree squared; intersection length and extent in degrees; coordinate diagnostics only, not metric area/distance.
